name: SEIWA HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd.
summary: SEIWA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, makes and sells highway signs, inspection lanes and steel brackets, and provides electro-galvanizing and zinc plating for elevators and industrial machinery. It also designs and installs steel structures, sells industrial machinery, and makes electric wires and cables, ship engine covers and vacuum rubber molding machines. Incorporated in 2021, it has its headquarters in Nagoya, Japan.
